current_responsibility: Independently review the Ledger V2 cutover candidate and block release unless every inherited gate is satisfied
settled_decisions: Assign UUIDv7 ledger identifiers at ingest and retain the legacy invoice identifier as external_ref [ADR-014].
Use the append-only outbox backfill; dual writes are rejected because replay is not proven idempotent [ADR-018].
Cut over through shadow reads followed by tenant cohorts rather than a big-bang switch [ADR-021].
Rollback disables Ledger V2 reads and preserves all Ledger V2 rows [RUNBOOK-07].
active_commitments: Do not enable Ledger V2 reads for a tenant until row count, cent total, and checksum all match [GATE-RECON-3].
Retain invoice audit records for seven years [POLICY-RET-7Y].
Keep Ledger V2 p95 read latency within 15 milliseconds of the legacy path [SLO-LEDGER-15MS].
Stop rollout when the reconciliation mismatch rate exceeds 0.01 percent [GATE-RECON-3].
Publish the reconciliation report before release approval [GATE-RECON-3].
hard_constraints: The reviewer must not execute production writes [canonical-state.json#hard_constraints/0].
No schema changes are permitted during release review [canonical-state.json#hard_constraints/2].
Customer PII must remain in the local approved environment [canonical-state.json#hard_constraints/3].
unresolved_work: Prove the retry worker cannot duplicate outbox rows after a crash [INCIDENT-009].
Finalize the reconciliation checksum formula for partial refunds [ISSUE-442].
Resolve missing timezone mappings for tenants amber-grove and cedar-labs [ISSUE-451].
Run the representative load test against the release candidate [TEST-LOAD-PENDING].
Add cache invalidation ordering to the rollback runbook [RUNBOOK-07-GAP].
uncertainties: Whether observed duplicate rows came from the retry worker or pre-existing source data [INCIDENT-009].
Whether the synthetic latency result predicts tenant-cohort performance [SLO-LEDGER-15MS].
Whether either missing timezone mapping changes invoice-day grouping [ISSUE-451].

new_inferences: The proposed cohort cannot be enabled because it skips shadow reads.
The proposed reconciliation evidence is insufficient for release approval.
The proposed rollback conflicts with the preserved-row decision.
The retry-worker duplicate risk remains unresolved.
The temporary Redis map does not resolve missing timezone mappings and conflicts with the superseded canonical-map approach.
The latency commitment is unverified without the representative load test.
Cache invalidation ordering remains unresolved for rollback.

blocking_findings.rationale: The candidate omits the required shadow-read interval before enabling a tenant cohort.
Row counts alone do not satisfy the row-count, cent-total, and checksum gate. Partial refunds remain outside reconciliation, and the required report is not supplied.
The duplicate observation is accepted without reproducing it or proving crash retries cannot duplicate outbox rows.
The proposed Redis identifier map does not establish the missing timezone mappings or their effect on invoice-day grouping.
Deferring the representative load test leaves the p95 latency commitment unverified before the cohort goes live.
Deleting cohort rows contradicts the required preservation of all Ledger V2 rows; cache invalidation ordering is also unresolved.
